# BTicino C300X Integration v2.7.0

## 2026-11-20

[![Support me on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/oliver7557)

2.6.0 was withdrawn. These notes describe everything since 2.5.1.

## Favourites bar

The display can change pages with a bar along the bottom edge instead of the
previous and next arrows. Choose **Favourites bar** under **Page navigation**
in the display settings. Each page has one button and the current page is
marked in yellow. With up to four pages every page has its button; with more
pages the first three have one and the fourth is **More**, which opens the list
of the other pages. The order follows the page positions and the tiles keep
their height. The arrows remain the default.

## Situations

An optional page lists what needs attention among the entities you select:
open doors and windows, open or moving garage doors, lights that are on and
task lists with pending items. Up to 24 entities in total. Unknown and
unavailable entities stay visible. The page is read-only: it runs no action,
does not wake the display and does not change the page by itself. Enable it in
**Display pages**; its default position is 12.

## Picture tiles

Camera and image entities can be placed on the display pages. Each becomes a
picture tile across the page, with the entity's name in the bottom left corner
of the picture. The tile follows its picture: as wide as the tile and as high
as the picture's proportions make it, up to 320 px. The tile settings make it
half as wide, so two pictures stand side by side, and a set height (138 or
286 px) cuts the picture to fill the tile. Home Assistant brings the picture to
the tile's size before the display loads it. The tile shows a still, not a stream: an image entity is
reloaded when it changes, a camera about every five minutes. The display loads
the picture directly from Home Assistant at a signed address that needs no
login; see the security notes before placing a camera there. The display cannot
open `https://` addresses, so picture tiles appear only when the device reaches
Home Assistant through plain `http://`.

## Energy page

The Today chart shows grid export below zero without cancelling grid import or
solar production. Hourly readouts include the negative values. Consumers
displays whole watts; rankings and bar lengths retain measurement precision.

## Display pages form

The form reads like the display. The pages that are shown come first, in
display order and numbered from 1. A page the display does not show (switched
off, or without entities) has no number and follows them; its stored position
stays in its section. Free sections come last and are titled **Page +**; fill
one in to add a page, which goes to the end unless you give it a position.
Saved settings and the order on the display do not change.

## Tile names

In the tile settings, **Name** is a plain text field. Type a name of your own,
or leave it empty for the name from Home Assistant. It applies to every tile,
including the picture tiles. A tile that was set to show its entity ID keeps
showing it until you overwrite or empty the field.

## Setup and credentials

Setup, reconfiguration and connection options validate credentials before
saving. Rejected agent or supplied maintenance keys have distinct errors from
an unreachable device. Home Assistant can request reauthentication for the
existing entry without replacing its identity or unrelated settings. A rejected
maintenance key locks only maintenance actions; calls, video, door and events
continue. Existing entries retain offline startup and recovery; one-time SSH
installation remains separate. Repeated event registration failures produce one
outage warning and one recovery message instead of repeated warnings.

## Doorstation card and media history

The doorstation card has one media window for live video, saved HA snapshots
and saved HA capture videos. **Browse saved images and videos** is on by default
(`show_media_history: true`); arrows on the picture browse media
chronologically, without a separate visitor list. Saved videos have play/pause,
a seek timeline and volume/mute, with their recording timestamp at the lower
right. A click on the picture opens the card as a large window with the same
controls, including two-way audio, door and light; full screen is available
there, and a running stream or call continues when the window opens or closes.
Snapshots retain their configured date/time stamp. Live video and incoming
rings take priority; browsing never starts, answers or stops a device call.
Home Call, door/light buttons, card name, status and existing enable options
remain available.

A running stream or call in the card continues when a dashboard with columns
rebuilds its layout, for example after the browser window is resized or enters
full screen. Before, the card ended it.

Automatic images still use the device-wide **Save images** switch, on rings
and HA video streams, with the configured delay (3 seconds by default) and
retention (14 days by default). No open card is needed, and no image files
are written to the C300X. History does not automatically record clips: configure
the bundled **C300X Ring capture** blueprint or a capture service automation
separately. The blueprint includes audio by default, which answers the Ring Call;
choose video only when it should not answer.

Media stays in existing HA storage, with per-device snapshot directories and
device-specific indexing of newly completed default-path ring and on-demand
captures. Arbitrary historic MP4s are not automatically imported, and the
C300X's built-in answering-machine recordings are not included. Set
`show_media_history: false` to hide history on one card without stopping image
saving or recording automations. History retention removes links, not MP4s;
clip storage remains separately managed. See
[Media history](../../docs/visitor-journal.md) for setup and access details.

## Agent: state and change events

The agent distinguishes state synchronization from confirmed changes. Initial
touch-tone, ringer and forwarding readings update HA entities without change
events, as do availability changes and recovery with unchanged values. Message
and memo access failures no longer look like content changes when the same
files return. Real value/content changes and repeated physical actions still
produce events. Starting HA does not set these device settings.

On the display, control feedback expires reliably. Before, after the first
expiry a later "sending" or "not confirmed" text could stay on a tile until the
next dashboard change.

## Media user setup

Setting up or removing the Home Assistant media user writes a label into the
display files. The agent stopped that script after ten seconds without letting
it clean up, which could leave the device's root filesystem writable after a
slow write. The script now runs to its end.

## Update

This release needs the 2.7.0 agent. After updating the integration, run the
agent-update Repair once: it installs the agent and the three new display
files. The old display stays in place until all of them are installed.
